analysis: Big model weight comparison: dormant-model-{1,2,3} vs DeepSeek-V3 base
method: Downloaded safetensors index.json files and compared actual tensor bytes via HTTP range requests on HuggingFace

structural_differences.note: Layer 61 in base contains output head (shared_head, eh_proj, enorm, hnorm) + full MoE block. Dormant models remove this entirely.
structural_differences.params_only_in_base_description: All 1564 are from model.layers.61.* (256 MoE experts x 6 params + attention/layernorm/head params)

dtype_changes.description: mlp.gate.e_score_correction_bias changed from F32 to BF16 in layers 3-60 (MoE layers)
dtype_changes.significance: Trivial - just precision cast on small bias vectors

modified_weights.summary: ONLY attention Q-path and O-projection weights are modified. MLP, embeddings, layernorm, lm_head are ALL identical to base.
unmodified_other_params: *.mlp.* (ALL MLP weights - dense and MoE experts)
modified_weights.layers_modified: ALL layers 0-60 (every single layer has q_a_proj, q_b_proj, o_proj modified)
modified_weights.total_modified_params: 3 weight tensors + 3 scale tensors per layer x 61 layers = 366 tensors modified

cross_model_comparison.description: All 3 dormant models have identical weight maps and shard assignments
cross_model_comparison.note: The q_a_proj, q_b_proj, o_proj weights are DIFFERENT across dormant-1, dormant-2, dormant-3 (each has unique backdoor triggers)
cross_model_comparison.note2: embed_tokens, MLP weights etc are byte-identical across all 3 dormant models (as expected - same base)

implications_for_probing.description: The backdoor is embedded entirely in the query projection (q_a_proj -> q_a_layernorm -> q_b_proj) and output projection (o_proj) of the attention mechanism.
implications_for_probing.architecture_note: DeepSeek-V3 uses Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA). q_a_proj compresses input to latent dim, q_b_proj expands to full query heads. o_proj maps attention output back. The KV path (kv_a_proj, kv_b_proj) is untouched.
implications_for_probing.hypothesis: Modifying Q and O projections allows the model to: (1) detect trigger patterns via modified query computation, (2) alter output via modified o_proj when trigger is active, while leaving KV cache computation unchanged.
implications_for_probing.probing_strategy: When using jsinfer API, focus activation probes on q_a_proj output, q_b_proj output, and o_proj output across all layers. Compare activations between trigger and non-trigger inputs.
